text: Noor built a solid Streamlit app for us that organized 38k marketplace reviews into 12 stable themes and let us track sentiment by week. The Python work was clean, and the combination of BERTopic, Hugging Face Transformers, and pandas was a good fit for what we needed. It ended up replacing about 2 days a month of manual tagging, which was a real win for our team. My only complaint is that communication could have been a bit tighter at times, but the technical result was strong.
